events.verdict: Castle (SAS) and Vucevic (CHI) briefly engage off of the ball.
Castle (SAS) places a hand on Jones' (CHI) back before releasing away.
Fox (SAS) is moving alongside Dosunmu's (CHI) path and the ensuing body contact between the two players is marginal.
Vucevic (CHI) inadvertently steps on Castle's (SAS) foot and the two players fall to the floor as a result of the incidental contact.
Barnes (SAS) cleanly blocks Jones' (CHI) shot attempt before the ball touches the backboard. Once the ball is loose, Wembanyama (SAS) then blocks it off of the rim and legally retrieves the rebound.
Vucevic (CHI) directly contests Wembanyama's (SAS) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Wembanyama's (SAS) hand after the release.
Fox (SAS) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Jones (CHI) commits a take foul on Castle (SAS).
Castle (SAS) commits a take foul on Jones (CHI).
Barnes (SAS) wraps an arm around Huerter (CHI), affecting his FOM. The illegal contact by Barnes precedes Huerter hooking his arm and a defensive foul is correctly called.
Huerter (CHI) commits a take foul on Wembanyama (SAS).
Dosunmu (CHI) is in bounds when he receives the ball.
